nodes.asset_description: A woman with dark hair pulled back wears large, light-colored sunglasses with dark lenses. She is wearing a white collared shirt. The background is blurred, showing a street with traffic lights and trees. The woman's expression is neutral.

A woman with brown hair and sunglasses lies on her side on a light-colored paved surface. She wears a white short-sleeved shirt and light beige or khaki pants. Her head is turned slightly to the right, and her right arm rests near her left hand. The background is dark and out of focus.

A woman with long brown hair sits on a stone-paved surface, wearing a white sleeveless top and white pants. She wears light-colored sunglasses with brown frames. Her left hand rests on her left knee, and her right hand is placed on her right thigh. She looks upward and to the right. The background is out of focus and dark.

Close-up of a woman's right shoulder and upper chest. She wears a white tank top with a scoop neckline. Her skin tone is medium-brown, and her hair is pulled back from her face. The background is blurred and light-colored.

A man and a woman stand side by side on a sidewalk. The woman wears a white sleeveless crop top and white high-waisted pants with wide-leg pants and white sneakers. She has shoulder-length brown hair and is wearing sunglasses. The man wears a white short-sleeved button-down shirt over a white t-shirt, khaki shorts, and brown sandals. He wears sunglasses and has short dark hair. Behind them are red brick buildings with windows and balconies. Other people are visible in the background walking on the sidewalk.

A woman and a man stand in front of a glass building. The woman wears a white sleeveless top and white high-waisted trousers. She has dark hair and is wearing white-framed sunglasses. The man wears a light gray short-sleeved shirt with a small geometric pattern, gray shorts, and dark sunglasses. Both are looking directly at the camera.

Two individuals stand in front of a large glass window. The woman on the left wears a white sleeveless crop top and light beige trousers, with her hands in her pockets. She has dark hair and is wearing clear-framed sunglasses. The man on the right wears a light gray patterned short-sleeved shirt and matching shorts, with dark sunglasses and short dark hair. Both are looking directly at the camera.
